Wave scope: the deck chain p1a FOR-221 -> p1b FOR-220 -> p2 FOR-222 -> p3a FOR-223 -> p3b FOR-224 -> p4a FOR-225 -> p4b FOR-226 -> p4c FOR-227+228 -> p5a FOR-229 -> p5b FOR-230, strictly serial (Pass N reads Pass N-1). SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH: L0 reads this file fresh at every phase launch and passes invariants/gates/policy VERBATIM as Workflow args. Inline re-specification is forbidden — a typo in one phase's args must be impossible. Entries are flat strings because the frozen script renders them with INV.map(v => '- ' + v). Registry changes require an L0 commit + a launch-queue.jsonl note.

New stamp: bytes 40906 / sha1-12 a8b8cbd287dc. FREEZE-BREAK #r3-8 (2026-07-29, conductor-ruled): args.conductorRuling — a settled answer to a PRIOR DECISION-NEEDED, so a halted phase can be resumed past it. Injected into EXACTLY three prompt sites (L2 gate, L2 integration, and the review-lens dispatch) and deliberately NOT into the implementer's: on resumeFromRunId the impl agent's (prompt, opts) must stay byte-identical so its work replays from cache, while precisely the checkers that raised the decision re-run informed by the ruling. Stating a ruling in the shared scope/acceptance text instead — the only option before this — invalidated every cache entry including impl's, costing a full re-run of the most expensive stage against an already-complete branch. Found by p3a (FOR-223), whose integration checker correctly halted on a promotion-seam gap the conductor's own brief had created. Applied identically to the all-Opus variant (its own registry, freeze #opus-2) so the two scripts never diverge in capability. New stamp: bytes 36716 / sha1-12 0948a8cce88a. FREEZE-BREAK #r3-7 (2026-07-24, operator-ratified morning ceremony): MUTATION ISOLATION for parallel review-phase flip-performers. Overnight r3-sweep evidence: Round C was ALREADY self-isolating (its brief carries the full scratch-worktree recipe), yet shared-checkout flip-test collisions still occurred (phase-1 models.ts, phase-6 thermo-nuclear-review.js) — the writers were the OTHER flip-performers running in parallel: rounds A/B and the local-CR loop's flip-proofs. Fix: new shared MUTATION_ISOLATION prose clause (scratch-worktree recipe + launch-checkout ban + leak check + zero-mutations-trivially-satisfied) wired '+ MUTATION_ISOLATION' into EXACTLY three prompts: round A brief, round B brief, local-CR prompt (the local-CR wire carries a CARVE-OUT: fix-application edits amended into the phase commit stay in the launch checkout; only flip-proofs/probe-reverts isolate). Round C untouched (negative-space pinned — keeps its stronger DO-NOT-trust variant). Guard-tested test-first in scripts/td-phase-lifecycle-gate-mechanics.test.ts (4 new tests: clause definition w/ recipe+ban+leak regexes, wire-count === 3, Round-C negative space, carve-out ordering pin) — RED first (3 fail, negative-space green), then GREEN 17/17; check-workflows green. Predicates untouched. New stamp: bytes 35745 / sha1-12 7e4338cd0a27. Prior: FREEZE-BREAK #r3-6 (2026-07-23, FOR-759 gate-mechanics stack, branch 3/3 fix/for-759-postprek-diff-guard): the L2 gate-checker re-ran the offline gates + exit gate itself but had no INDEPENDENT tree-cleanliness check of its own — it relied entirely on trusting the exit-gate runner's self-reported ok/dirty flag (defense-in-depth gap: a prek run that mutates the working tree during the gate-checker's OWN re-run could, in principle, go unnoticed if the reviewer never looks itself). Added a new bullet to l2Prompts.gate (ONLY — the integration-reviewer prompt does not run gates and is untouched): immediately after the gate re-runs finish, the gate-checker must run `git status --porcelain` itself and treat ANY output as an UNCONDITIONAL FAIL finding, quoted verbatim in evidence — never a silent pass, independent of the runner's own dirty flag. Guard-tested test-first in scripts/td-phase-lifecycle-gate-mechanics.test.ts (3 new tests, extending the FOR-759 suite): the gate-checker prompt (sliced from its own 'You are the L2 GATE-CHECKER' marker to the integration-reviewer's marker) matches /git status --porcelain/i and /UNCONDITIONAL FAIL/i; a negative-space test confirms the integration-reviewer prompt slice does NOT pick up the same check (scope containment). Predicate exitGateBlockReason and implGateRetryFeedback (r3-5) UNTOUCHED; full suite green (14/14 in the FOR-759 file; 1372 total offline, up from 1369). New stamp: bytes 34311 / sha1-12 108acb544ffb. Prior: FREEZE-BREAK #r3-5 (2026-07-23, FOR-759 gate-mechanics stack, branch 2/3 fix/for-759-post-prek-regate): a re-run of ONLY the exit-gate runner after a prek auto-fix (DIRTY_TREE) was insufficient — the offline gates (typecheck/test/lint) the implementer ran in step 3 certified the PRE-fix tree, not the one that gets amended in, so a commit could reach GREEN having never had offline gates run against its FINAL committed content. Two-layer fix: (1) Implement step 5 prompt now explicitly instructs RE-RUN BOTH gate sets ON THE AMENDED TREE after folding prek's fixes, before re-running the exit-gate runner — 'a commit is never accepted GREEN on a re-run of the runner alone'. scriptFreeze.policy: frozen-unless-broken for the whole sweep wave: any mechanics change is a freeze-break — fix, commit, log break + new stamp in the launch-queue.jsonl note, surface in the phase report. Wanted-but-deferred improvements go to the queue notes, applied as one commit at sprint end. Generalization guard: script changes only if they'd hold on a different sprint/repo/machine.
scriptFreeze.launchRule: launch via scriptPath (byte-verified persisted copy), NOT by name — the name registry serves a session-start snapshot; args may arrive as a JSON string (script parses at boundary). RESUMES are POLICY-ONLY: policy values appear in no agent prompts, so a policy-only resume replays the cached prefix and runs only the missing agents; amending scope/acceptance/invariants on a resume changes every BRIEF and silently forces a full re-run. Invariants are PER-SPRINT data — revise this registry's invariants array at each sprint's window-zero. BRIEF-AS-FILE (adopted mid-r2, 2026-07-06): long scope/acceptance payloads go in .claude/workflows/briefs/<phase>.md with pointer-scope args — the harness's stringification of large inline phase payloads produced an invalid-JSON args boundary failure twice deterministically (G1-t2 runs wf_bba482e4-da7 + wf_2946f030-05b, 'Expected }' at parse, 0 agents); the slim-args relaunch cleared it. Invariants stay inline (registry-verbatim, proven size). EMISSION RULE (r2 F1 lessons t1/t3): brief text and agent report strings are prompt-material — zero backslashes, no raw newlines inside JSON string fields, describe commands in words, paraphrase instead of quoting escape-bearing code.

invariants: runs/ wire-format keys stay snake_case in nested domain payloads — NEVER rename a serialized contract key (guard-teeth: renaming one key in a domain schema must turn a test RED). The golden-run directory runs/da496ff8 is ABSENT at this base (runs/ is gitignored; committed fixtures are runs/pinned-golden-run research JSONs AND runs/pinned-golden-deck dated stage baselines (ADD-never-replace; see its README)) — never invent measurements against it; use synthetic fixtures only and say so in reports.

A1 branding guard: validateSpineRefs keeps param type Record<string, ResearchArtifact>; the claimRef.source_agent join key stays UNBRANDED (standing guard: src/core/spine-validation.test.ts). Zod enums/brands for agent names must NEVER validate or brand the spine join key — boundary validation stops at the artifact write-site.

A2 INVARIANT propagation: the bare validateSpineRefs calls at src/core/synthesis.ts, synthesis-streaming.ts, synthesis-phase.ts (two sites), run-manager.ts forkRun, and adapters/cli-checkpoint.ts run as BARE statements OUTSIDE any try/catch — refactors must never wrap them. EXCEPTION by documented design: adapters/http-checkpoint.ts wraps its call in the boundary-conversion pattern (FOR-489 era) — that wrap is CORRECT there. The NEW deck gate validateDeckRefs (p4a DEFINES in src/core/deck-validation.ts as a pure void-returning throwInvariant sibling — DEFINITION SITE AMENDED 2026-07-31, conductor ruling D16: the prior deck-rubric.ts pin put p4a's definition inside p4c's file, violating one-owner-per-hub-file; deck-validation.ts mirrors the validateSpineRefs/spine-validation.ts sibling precedent. p4c CALLS it from deck-rubric.ts, never redefines) inherits the SAME bare-statement discipline at every call site.

A3 orchestrator defense: the operator-edited-spine re-validation in src/core/synthesis-phase.ts stays. NEVER delete or weaken a defensive guard to satisfy a lint rule — findings on defense-in-depth get a type restructure or a justified per-line ignore, never guard removal.

Models come from env via researchModel()/synthesisModel()/assetsModel() and the NEW deckModel() (p3a DEFINES it as resolveModel(deps.model, requireModel(process.env.MODEL_DECK, MODEL_DECK)); p5b consumes; .env.example gains a MODEL_DECK entry) — ALL fail fast; never hardcode a model string; never reintroduce a silent model default or fallback (the drafted MODEL_DECK ?? synthesisModel() shape was REJECTED at window-zero as an invariant violation). Keep models.ts CAPABILITY_MODEL_IDS and cost.ts KNOWN_MODEL_IDS in sync when adding families; sonnet-5 intro pricing runs through 2026-08-31 (FOR-782 owns the cutover bump).

D4 DECK LIFECYCLE (operator-ruled 2026-07-23): the deck is a POST-FINALIZE SUB-LIFECYCLE BRANCH of the pipeline. The RunPhase union (researching<synthesizing<awaiting_checkpoint<generating_assets<finalized) is UNTOUCHED — finalized stays terminal and SEALED for core artifacts. A NEW forward-only sealed DeckPhase typestate (landed p3a, shape ratified in src/domain/deck.ts) governs ALL runs/<id>/deck writes, with deck state persisted under deck/. Entry surfaces (p5b): post-run offer, agx deck run-id on a finalized run in place, --with-deck as pre-answer. Never weaken the run seal to admit deck writes; never write deck artifacts outside the DeckPhase guard. DECKPHASE ADDITIVE EXTENSION (operator-RULED 2026-07-29, interview D1): p4a MAY add the deck_visuals member and p5a the deck_polishing member — exactly these two, additive, nothing else; the enum re-freezes after p5a.

D2 CHECKPOINT-2 (operator-ruled, MATERIAL PRE-APPROVED): CheckpointPort gains requestDeckApproval — p2 updates ALL FIVE implementers in one branch (cli-checkpoint, http-checkpoint, auto-checkpoint adapters + the two live-test doubles in synthesis-phase.live.test.ts and asset-phase.live.test.ts). CheckpointDecision gains its plan analog. Any FURTHER checkpoint wire change beyond this ratified shape is a STOP+DECISION. AMENDMENT (operator-RULED 2026-07-31, FOR-818): stated_needs flows recommend-then-confirm — p5b derives the suggested set from research/spine discovery-needs data; Checkpoint #2 presents it for confirmation/collection/override (operator edit WINS, mirroring the layout-composition flow). Carrying stated_needs through the deck-approval checkpoint as an ADDITIVE field is pre-approved for p5b — that specific change only; anything further remains STOP+DECISION.

SINGLE-OWNERSHIP PINS (grouping lens, window-zero): validateDeckRefs defined ONLY in p4a; deckModel defined ONLY in p3a; RunContext deck bus methods — writeDeckPlan/readDeckPlan p2 (AMENDED 2026-07-28 p2-ceremony: the enumeration omitted the plan writer; producer-owns-the-write, plain RunContext methods now, p3a brings deck writes under the DeckPhase guard), writeDeckScaffold/readDeckScaffold p3a, writeDeckDoc/readDeckDoc p3b, visuals bus method p4a, writeAuditReport + writeRubricReport p4c, writeDeckFinal p5b; downstream phases CONSUME, never redeclare. deckPlan schema is p2-DEFINED in src/domain/deck.ts (AMENDED 2026-07-28: the deck.ts header comment drifted at p1b, listing deckPlan under p3a's pins — FOR-222's Contracts-owned is authoritative; p2 corrects that comment line) and INCLUDES slides_per_arc as a number array AND arc_count (p2 produces, p3a consumes — the probe shape that omitted them was corrected at window-zero). LAYOUT-COMPOSITION FLOW (operator-RATIFIED 2026-07-28): deckPlan ALSO carries per-arc layout_composition — ordered layout_name refs validated against the layout library (brandPackage.slide_layouts on extract; neutral built-in master on infer); planner RECOMMENDS, DECK_LAYOUT_MAP env pre-seeds, Checkpoint #2 confirm/adjust WINS (one deck gate — no separate layout checkpoint); p3a consumes the CONFIRMED composition for slide stubs; RECAP-AS-REFERENCE THROUGH PROMOTION (conductor-RULED 2026-07-29, resolving p3a's DECISION-NEEDED): p3a encodes the rubric 6.4-defect-2 fix on slideStub plus deckScaffold, but the p1b-owned promotion target deckSlide/deckDoc had no field able to carry it. RULING: p3b MAY extend deckDoc and deckSlide ADDITIVELY (optional or defaulted fields ONLY; zero renames, zero removals, zero new REQUIRED fields) and the never-redefines-shapes pin is AMENDED for exactly this one-time case — the pin's stated purpose is that intermediate deckDocs always parse, which an additive field preserves, so this is faithful to its intent rather than an exception. The promoted doc MUST be SELF-CONTAINED: the renderer resolves recap slides from the doc alone, never by re-reading scaffold.json (that silently widens PptxRenderPort.render's input) and never from duplicated payloads (that reintroduces the very defect). Mirror p3a's names and shapes so promotion is a COPY, not a translation. GUARD-TEETH REQUIRED: a duplication test AND a backward-parse pin. Shapes FREEZE AGAIN after p3b. the render-geometry placement upgrade is RATIFIED for p3b (renderer places content into the assigned layout's placeholder geometry, replacing fixed regions). DeckSlide SCHEMA STABILITY (FOR-226 probe 2026-07-23; ownership AMENDED 2026-07-26 build-order fix — the render port signature needs DeckDoc three phases before p3b, per FOR-230's ratify-shapes-upfront note): the deck DOCUMENT shapes (deckArc, deckSlide FULL base including body and callouts as OPTIONAL fields, deckDoc) are defined at P1B alongside the port that consumes them; p3a defines slideStub/deckScaffold; p3b owns the scaffold-to-doc promotion + writeDeckDoc/readDeckDoc and NEVER redefines shapes; p4b POPULATES body/callouts and enforces density (later passes must not mutate shapes, so intermediate deckDocs always parse). The density targets (word median 46, p95 under 126 — source docs/deck-pipeline-vision.md section 6 Pass 4 and the deck-rubric v1/v2 base inventory word_count_stats; CITATION CORRECTED 2026-07-29 — the v3 delta doc does not restate these numbers, the prior v3-sections-1-and-4 citation was wrong) live as ONE deck.ts constant defined in p4b and referenced (never re-stated) by p4c's deckRubric. ACCENT-CARRY (operator-RULED 2026-07-31, FOR-819): p5a adds an ADDITIVE optional callout-accent field to deckSlide (optional/defaulted ONLY — the recap-ruling faithful-to-intent test; intermediate deckDocs always parse), the p4b population seam carries accent_role through, and the renderer paints per-callout accent roles — colorblind-safe evidence discipline intact (programmatic hex-equality on role tokens, role name + hex labels). Owner: p5a, alongside its formatting-bucket scope.

PipelineEvent: deck members are ADDITIVE union members only (FOR-731/HEX-1b precedent) — NEVER widen the existing phaseName enum (PREMISE CORRECTED 2026-07-29, measured at 8b9259a: the web event router in usePipelineEvents.ts is now an EXHAUSTIVE switch with a never guard — a new member REDS the web typecheck LOUDLY until its case lands; add the case in the same branch, which is the desirable failure mode the old if/else lacked). Adding a member is EDIT-THEN-REGENERATE in the same branch: edit src/core/events.ts, then REGENERATE web/app/lib/events.ts via scripts/codegen-events.ts (the mirror is generated — NEVER hand-edit it; scripts/codegen-events.test.ts reds on drift, landed dev PR #131, which retired the former p0 parity-fixture plan).

Two agent shapes — deck passes are the synthesis shape: every deck pass, the planner, the audit and the rubric gate are a single anthropic.messages.parse + zodOutputFormat call producing a CostRecord via estimateCost — never an AgentBase query() loop (that shape is for research agents only).

No hardcoded org identity: anchor = ANCHOR_ORG_*, prospect = PROSPECT_ORG_* (default USAA); brand colors are ROLES (vendor_accent/buyer_accent) resolved from brandPackage, never hex literals in code. docs/deck-rubric-v3.md uses Insurity/USAA as EXAMPLE orgs and reference-deck measured hexes — that is documentation provenance, not license to hardcode.

Offline tests = env -u RUN_LIVE_LLM_TESTS bun run test (vitest). The env-u prefix is MANDATORY on every offline gate run AND every git commit (the session shell may export RUN_LIVE_LLM_TESTS=1). NEVER bun test — bun's native runner mishandles vi.* and the live-skip guard. Offline floor at the sprint base (dev 3192fa6 == trunk 4ece9fc src tree, measured 2026-08-02): 3026 passed | 69 skipped (3095), exit 0; typecheck clean; lint 0 errors 1 info (pre-existing, not yours). Live gate: doppler run -p sales-collateral-agx -c dev -- bun run test:live (testModel = haiku); e2e is haiku-flaky — discriminate flake vs defect under the sonnet true-gate before ruling a regression.
Live-test skips are INTENTIONAL (RUN_LIVE_LLM_TESTS-gated describe.skip) — never un-skip, delete, or fix them to satisfy a rule.

.pre-commit-config.yaml is operator-gated — ZERO edits. detect-secrets flags full 40-hex SHAs in committed text files: use short 7-char SHAs in ledger/doc prose. semgrep p/ci (pre-push) requires GitHub Actions pinned to full commit SHAs and bunfig [install] exact = true with minimumReleaseAge 604800 — never loosen either; the NEW pptxgenjs dependency (p1b) must be pinned exact at a version at least 7 days old and bun install verified at ceremony.

Remediation changes behavior BY DESIGN — but ONLY within the phase's acceptance-defined delta. Any observable behavior change NOT named in the phase acceptance is drift: a FAIL finding, never a note. Preflight probe paths can go stale: re-verify every cited file:line against HEAD with a targeted grep or read before the first edit.

NEVER use git stash in this repository — the stash stack is SHARED across the main checkout and all worktrees with concurrent sessions. Measure pre-change baselines via git show against the parent ref or committed state. Parity briefs must enumerate execution PATHS, not just channels: live pipeline vs demo/scripted vs CLI can each have a DIFFERENT sole owner for the same event/behavior (hex-sprint lesson).

VISUAL VERIFICATION (operator-ruled 2026-07-25; renderer rails AMENDED 2026-07-26 on measured evidence): TWO RAILS. Agent/CI rail — from p1b onward, every phase whose output changes rendered deck content runs scripts/render-deck-preview.ts (SOFFICE-HEADLESS ONLY: soffice convert-to pdf then magick/ghostscript PNGs, chain empirically proven; PowerPoint AppleScript export is a MEASURED NO-OP on 16.111.1 and must never be scripted) and attaches the preview PNG paths as report + validator evidence. Fidelity rail — the CONDUCTOR drives PowerPoint File-Export-PNG via computer-use at visual checkpoints (grants provisioned + proven 2026-07-26), outside phase runs; the conductor visually inspects the images and the operator receives them with each phase report. PHASE AGENTS NEVER INVOKE GUI TOOLS (computer-use, screenshots, osascript app control) — the p1b first traversal died blocked on a GUI approval dialog; a capability gap is a STOP+DECISION, never a GUI escalation. Color-SEMANTIC checks are asserted programmatically on role tokens (hex equality in code), NEVER by eye; visual review targets layout truth (overflow, overlap, density, placement, register). Any color mention in evidence carries a text label (role name + hex) — never a hue-only judgment (colorblind-safe evidence discipline).

SET-AT-CUT (re-stamped 2026-08-02 for the deck-build-hardening sprint; prior stamps 2026-07-23 / 2026-07-25): single shared worktree .claude/worktrees/m6-refinement; trunk = feature/deck-build-hardening @ 4ece9fc (dev 3192fa6 + the pinned-golden-deck baseline commit; gt trunk, upstream set). Phase branches are cut by the impl agent as first-act via gt create from the trunk checkout in the shared worktree. Verify pwd, branch, and clean tree before any edit; an unexpectedly dirty or foreign state is a STOP + DECISION, never a workaround. Conductor-owned files (.claude/workflows/launch-queue.jsonl, .claude/workflows/briefs/, .claude/workflows/td-phase-lifecycle.registry.json, .claude/workflows/sprint-manifest.json, runs/pinned-golden-deck/README.md) are never edited by phase agents. Their ON-BRANCH SNAPSHOTS LAG THE TRUNK BY DESIGN — phase branches fork before later conductor commits, so the copy in a phase-branch tree is historical, not authoritative; the SOURCE OF TRUTH is always the trunk checkout copy, which the conductor reads fresh and passes verbatim in args. Never diff a phase-branch snapshot of a conductor file against args-carried text and report the mismatch as drift (p1b-t2 false-alarm lesson). STACKED-PHASE NOTE (p2+): later phases cut from the PRIOR phase branch's tip, not from the trunk — the same verify-pwd/branch/clean discipline applies with the parent named in args.

PUBLISHED-HISTORY APPEND-ONLY (operator-ruled 2026-07-31): phase agents publish branches via gt commands or the Graphite MCP ONLY — never raw git push variants, never any force-push. Amend is legal ONLY while the branch is local-only; once the branch exists on origin, every fix lands as a FOLLOW-UP COMMIT published via gt submit (fast-forward always). A fixer that believes it needs force has hit a STOP+DECISION, not a flag choice. A multi-commit phase branch is the EXPECTED shape under this rule — never flag follow-up commits as drift. First-occurrence tolerance was granted for the p4b round-1 raw force-push; the rule is binding from 2026-07-31 onward. AUTHORSHIP COROLLARY (conductor-added 2026-08-01, after a p5a review fixer amended the CONDUCTOR's own follow-up commit 9f14bfc while the branch was still local-only — legal under the rule as written, and every push was fast-forward with zero force, but it erased a separately-authored artifact and its message): NEVER amend a commit you did not author, even while the branch is local-only. Amend applies ONLY to your own uncommitted-to-origin work; anyone else's commit — conductor, prior fixer, prior stage — gets a FOLLOW-UP commit. Rationale: authorship boundaries are what make the audit trail readable, and the amend-of-another's-commit shape is indistinguishable from history rewriting to every downstream reader and every safety heuristic.

OPEN DECISIONS MUST BE RULED OR DATED (conductor rule, 2026-08-02, after a p0t-surfaced OPEN DECISION rode unruled through SEVEN phases and then blocked the first real-scale run). A phase that discovers a fork it cannot own writes it down and routes it up — that is CORRECT and must keep happening. The failure mode is on the RECEIVING side: the conductor accepted it into a report and never closed it. RULE: every OPEN DECISION, DECISION-NEEDED, or equivalent a phase surfaces gets, at the very next done-window, EITHER an explicit ruling recorded in the ledger AND written back over the originating comment, OR a dated deferral naming the phase or issue that will own it. Silence is not a third option. SEMANTIC EQUIVALENTS COUNT — the vocabulary varies and that is precisely how these hide: 'not owned by this phase', 'surfaced to the conductor', 'whichever option is chosen replaces this paragraph', 'route to the VP', 'TBD', and the disguised form where a constant is documented as REASONED-NOT-MEASURED, provisional, or estimated with the real value deferred to a future run. A deferred measurement is a decision wearing a number's clothes. EXEMPLAR: deck-tokens.ts pinned the content passes at DECK_MAX_NON_STREAMING_TOKENS, enumerated three ways out, named the phase that would hit the ceiling, and asked for a choice; seven phases later a 42-slide deck truncated on exactly that ceiling (FOR-834 closes it).

FIXERS NEVER AMEND — FOLLOW-UP COMMITS ONLY (conductor rule 2026-08-03, occurrences 2+3 of the cross-author amend class in ONE run after p5a 9f14bfc: p2-for839 fix:review#1 amended the impl agent commit 9168f36 with --no-verify, and a later fixer amended fe3e845 — both while the authorship corollary rode verbatim in their own args). Operative rule for every fix/review/triage stage: NEVER run git commit --amend and NEVER pass --no-verify, regardless of branch publish state or who authored HEAD — every fix is a follow-up commit, even on your own work once a review stage begins. The validator/publish stage MUST check the branch reflog for amend events after the impl stage final tip and report any as a FAIL finding (mechanical enforcement until the script-level guard lands — freeze-break queue item d). AMEND-CHECK DISCRIMINATOR (2026-08-03, meta-review p3 finding 5 — the reflog tripwire false-fired on 100% of commits): a Mergify Change-Id ceremony amend (tree-equal AND parent-equal AND same-author AND Change-Id-only message delta) PASSES silently; anything else FAILS. Mechanization target: scripts/audit-branch-amends.ts (freeze-break queue).

FLIP-PROOF EXTENDS TO FIXERS (2026-08-03, meta-review p1 finding 11, extends the p4d GUARD-TEETH rule): every guard, fallback branch, or negative-path test added in a fix commit ships its own flip-to-RED evidence in the fixer report, not just impl TDD.

ENV KNOB => HERMETICITY GUARD IN THE SAME PHASE (2026-08-03, third env-contamination instance after RUN_LIVE_LLM_TESTS and p0t reserve-env; meta-review p1 finding 4): a phase that adds env-resolved config ships file-level env scrub/pin hooks in every test file touching the seam, and its acceptance includes one polluted-env run of the touched suites as evidence. Env-sensitivity discovered post-hoc is phase-introduced debt, ticketed at the done-window.

DIVERGENCES ARE RECONCILED, NEVER RELAYED (2026-08-03, meta-review p2 finding 1: a fixed defect shipped to the conductor as the top ruling request and misled two review lenses): the final result re-judges every Phase-1 impl divergence against the DELIVERED tip — the Validate step re-tests each and stamps it RESOLVED-BY-FIXER(<sha>) or STILL-OPEN; only STILL-OPEN items reach the conductor as rulings. Implemented in the script at freeze #opus-2.

RESIDUAL OVERLAP IS FATAL (operator-ruled 2026-08-02; promoted to the registry 2026-08-03 per meta-review p3 finding 1 — the ruling reached two consecutive phases only via checker failure): any residual overlap or degenerate-region outcome in deck placement/render REFUSES with the typed door (ERR_DECK_TYPESET_OVERLAP / ERR_DECK_TYPESET_OVERFLOW) pre-vendor — never auto-repair, never squeeze or scale, never report-and-proceed (source ruling text: pptx-placement.ts:112-116).

REVIEW ISOLATION IS HARNESS-ENFORCED (2026-08-04, meta-review p4 finding 1 — FOURTH shared-checkout contamination: r3-p1 models.ts, r3-p6 thermo-nuclear-review.js, p4 run-1 terminal block on a foreign blob reverting a ruled fix, and a stray budget probe in the main checkout): review and L2 agents run in ephemeral isolated worktrees (script freeze #opus-3: isolation:'worktree' + detach-at-phase-tip first-acts); the shared launch worktree is READ-ONLY to reviewers (git show only). Prompt-level isolation is never the load-bearing layer.

A DELIVERED CI JOB EXECUTES ONCE WITH EVIDENCE BEFORE SUBMITTED (2026-08-04, p4 finding 2: the render-gate shipped with zero executions in any environment while workflow_dispatch was available the whole time): the report carries the run URL, conclusion, and duration; workflow_dispatch is the standing mechanism when base-branch gating blocks the PR event. AMENDED 2026-08-07 (p8 finding 5, third occurrence, first post-codification — run-2's first dispatch even targeted the wrong SHA): CI dispatch is a PUBLISH-STAGE EXIT CONDITION with schema-required evidence {runUrl, headSha === delivered tip, conclusion}; the ts-live weekly lane is QUARANTINED under FOR-741 (documented flake) and its failure never blocks, but its quarantine is cited, not silent.

GREEN AND A STOP-CLASS DIVERGENCE ARE MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE (2026-08-04, p4 finding 3 — document-and-proceed recurred through the divergences channel): a dirty tree, foreign or uncommitted files, or wrong-checkout state is status DECISION at the implementer and FAIL at the validator; enforced in both prompts at freeze #opus-3.

CONFIG DOOR IMPLIES BUILD-SITE ENUMERATION IN THE BRIEF (2026-08-04, meta-review p6 — 3rd occurrence of enumerate-execution-PATHS: hex-refactor lesson; p6 run-1's POST /api/runs finding; scripts/measure-golden-deck.ts hard-coding brand_template_path:null so every golden-deck measurement exercises only the inferred path): a brief that adds or gates a config field enumerates at probe time EVERY build site of the config object (grep the constructor/type) and states per-site coverage in scope — through-the-door, deliberately-not, or deferred-with-owner. The measurement/eval entry point is MANDATORY in that enumeration: a harness that cannot exercise a door the product promise names either gets wired in the same phase or its reports declare the un-exercised door explicitly (global failure-semantics rule, measurement arm).

SCOPE BINDS TO ACS; ACS PIN INVARIANTS, NOT MECHANISMS (2026-08-04, meta-review p6 — the FOR-804 cross-check lived only in scope prose, appears exactly once in the entire run state, and vanished without a trace; AC6 named the refusal's seam and passed only via validator charity): every scope obligation is bound to a numbered machine-checkable AC or an explicit owner+date at brief authoring — the lifecycle gates only on ACs, so unbound prose is unassigned work. ACs state invariants and observable outcomes ('safeArea never exceeds canvas'), never internal seam choices, unless the seam is itself settled contract. No AC assigns a disposition the phase's scoped inputs cannot decide: provision the missing input or pre-authorize measure-and-defer with a pre-named owner as a valid third disposition. EXTENDED 2026-08-07 (p8 finding 3: AC9 named 'bun run test:render' but the gates object never carried it — six stages accepted a path-filtered variant until validate ran it unfiltered): every command an AC names is diffed against the gates object at brief-cut; an AC-named command absent from gates is a brief-authoring FAIL.

PRECEDENCE CLAIMS CARRY DIRECTION; PRECEDENCE LIVES IN ONE TABLE (2026-08-04, meta-review p6 — 'template geometry beats DECK_MARGIN_*' with no direction qualifier cost run 1 whole: 9 agents / 2h05m to a gate-check DECISION the pre-launch interview could have settled; third precedence pair ruled across three phases): any 'X beats Y' in an issue or brief is not decision-complete until its direction/clamp semantics are stated as settled contract — an unqualified precedence claim is surfaced at the pre-launch operator interview, never discovered mid-run. All config-source precedence rulings (template vs env vs CLI vs defaults, incl. the tightening-only clamp) are recorded in ONE authoritative table that every pin cites; new precedence questions amend the table, not per-phase ruling prose.

PRODUCTION-PATH EXECUTION PIN (2026-08-05, meta-review p7 — widens CONFIG DOOR; occurrences: hex-refactor lesson, p6 POST /api/runs, measure-golden-deck brand_template_path:null, then >=3 inside p7 itself on the issue titled for this exact class): every NEW capability a brief adds (producer, artifact, guard, fallback, event) must, at probe time, name its production consumer AND the production call path that exercises it — including the consumer's accepted wire shape, with the invariant that permits that shape cited in any AC that asserts one. One numbered AC pins a test that executes the new code FROM THE PRODUCTION ENTRY POINT (pipeline/CLI/server route), not unit-land alone. Zero production references to a delivered capability at gate time is a FAIL; ship-with-ticket is NOT an admissible disposition for this class (R5 precedent: the gate's ship-as-is recommendation was overruled). A resume ruling is a brief for the resumed run and re-runs this enumeration on the seam it orders fixed.

A MINTED BASELINE IS NEVER GATE EVIDENCE (2026-08-07, meta-review p8 finding 8 — CI run-1 minted the appearance-baseline cache and run-2 compared against its own mint, cited three places as independent corroboration): baseline-consuming gates emit MINTED vs COMPARED distinguishably in their output, and only COMPARED runs count as gate evidence.

conductorRules.source: meta-review p1 (run wf_40c78149-cee) + p2-for839 amend forensics
rules: LEDGER APPENDS ARE MECHANIZED AND TRUNK-ONLY (third occurrence of the write-collision family: p0t launch-append race, p4a mis-landed commit, p1-for838 burned traversal): every launch-queue append happens via scripts/ledger-append.ts run in a checkout of the sprint trunk — it validates the row against _meta, commits immediately in its own commit, and never touches the shared worktree mid-phase. Any deliberate event-vocabulary change updates _meta in the SAME commit. Rotate the file per D12 at SPRINT-OPEN or record a dated D12 amendment — appending a new sprint to an unrotated file is a schema violation, not a convenience.

RULING WINDOWS END WITH A TRUNK PUSH (fourth origin-lags-local instance, created by the rulings-as-commits fix): any conductor window that lands commits on the sprint trunk pushes trunk to origin before the next launch/resume; launch and resume ceremony verifies origin trunk tip == local trunk tip; a publish agent using --ignore-out-of-sync-trunk always reports it as a divergence, never silently.

ACCEPTANCE NAMES THE FULL INVARIANT SURFACE (ex FOR-838: height-only fit gate, unmeasured separator joins, plan-level end-to-end): a refusal-gate AC enumerates EVERY axis of the invariant; a measured-table AC enumerates the production string classes the module will measure and budgets the measuring render in the same phase; an AC that promises end-to-end behavior is satisfied only by a STANDING test at that level — a validation-time probe proves the moment, not the future.

CONDUCTOR-OWNED FILES ARE READ FROM TRUNK (second SET-AT-CUT reviewer trap — a meta-review lens filed the snapshot lag as a major): any review, scan, or meta-review brief resolves the ledger, registry, and manifest via the trunk ref in the main checkout (git show <trunk>:<path>, materialized to a temp file), never a worktree snapshot. The watcher daemon already complies — it passes its own main-checkout ledger (workflow-runs.jsonl); the obligation binds CONDUCTOR-invoked meta-reviews passing launch-queue.jsonl.

GATE WAIVERS ARE RECORDED AT LAUNCH: any launch gate value differing from the registry carries a one-line waiver rationale in the LAUNCHED row, so the VERBATIM-from-registry rule stays literally true (first instance: p1-for838 liveRequired false, defensible but unrecorded).

D12 AMENDMENT (2026-08-03): the deck-build-hardening sprint continues in the unrotated launch-queue file; rotation happens at the next SPRINT-OPEN. This dated amendment satisfies the rotate-or-amend clause.

BRIEF PREMISES ARE PINNED, NOT RESTATED (2026-08-03, meta-review p2 finding 5 — five confirmed decomposition defects in one brief): before LAUNCHED: (a) every numeric premise cites the landed pin it derives from (test file + assertion at the parent tip); briefs cut before the parent landed are re-verified against the parent tip at dispatch; (b) every enumerated contract touch-point is grepped against the live schema — naming a nonexistent field is a decomposition defect; (c) any validation added to a domain schema declares whether that schema sits on a persisted-artifact READ path and pre-rules the compat shape (write-capped vs artifact-boundary split per the deckDoc/deckDocArtifact precedent, or an explicit K1 waiver); (d) repo docs are swept for OPEN DECISIONS pre-assigned to the issue being cut — the brief carries the ruling or explicitly delegates ruling authority with the recording convention; (e) when a mandated constraint and a scope exclusion can intersect, the brief pre-rules the collision regime instead of leaving the implementer to choose between violating scope and shipping a hole.

REGISTRY TEXT IS BYTE-VERBATIM AT LAUNCH (2026-08-03, meta-review p2 finding 7: an args invariant existed in no committed registry copy): args.invariants must byte-equal the trunk registry at dispatch; wording changes (even additive, even correct) land as an L0 registry commit BEFORE launch. The launch ceremony diffs args against the registry and refuses on mismatch.

STANDING RULINGS RIDE THE LAUNCH BRIEF (2026-08-03, meta-review p3 finding 1: the overlap ruling was in none of the 24 launch invariants and the first traversal burned on it): at phase cut, grep the touch-set for RULED/operator-ruling markers; any standing ruling governing the touch-set is PROMOTED INTO THE REGISTRY invariants before LAUNCHED — never ad-hoc args injection, so the byte-verbatim launch rule keeps holding.

ACCEPTANCE-WIDENED SEAMS NAME EVERY OCCUPANT (2026-08-03, p3 finding 1b: acceptance item 4 compelled a kind-blind bound with chart/table in the same band owned by nobody): when an acceptance item compels widening a seam (a bound, a gate, a schema), the brief enumerates EVERY occupant of that seam as in-scope or owner-named KNOWN NON-SCOPE — an unnamed occupant is a decomposition defect.

STATE FILES ARE ARCHIVED BEFORE RESUME (2026-08-04, p4 finding 4, 2nd occurrence: both p3 and p4 blocked-traversal agent evidence was destroyed by the resume rewrite): before any Workflow resume, the conductor copies wf_<id>.json to wf_<id>.run<N>.json beside it — blocked-traversal evidence is append-only history.

A PREDICTED DOWNSTREAM DELTA IS ITSELF AN AC (2026-08-04, p4 finding 5: the F3-fold rationale pinned a budget-shift prediction that measured ZERO while extents moved and the admit/refuse gap widened): any brief pinning a predicted propagation makes the prediction an acceptance check with a zero-delta DECISION trigger. The p4 budget-delta-0 question remains OPEN and gates the D14 mint.

BRIEF NUMBERS ARE MEASURED OR MARKED (2026-08-04, 3rd occurrence — fires and replaces the PRE-STAGED charter-counts rule; p5 casualties: the strips occupant model, an AC2 literal carrying the word MEASURED for an unprobed ~1.7 where the real pin measures 1.3722, and a 5-vs-6 assertion count): every number and geometric/mechanistic premise in a brief, AC, or conductor RULING is either (a) measured at the ACTUAL parent tip at cut/resume time with the probe cited (command + output), or (b) explicitly marked [ESTIMATE — falsifiable premise, divergence not DECISION]. The word MEASURED is reserved for values read from a probe run against the parent tip. ACs pin PROPERTIES (hex-equality, non-vacuity, roles-asserted-different), never mechanism-bound literals or counts, so a falsified premise downgrades to a divergence report instead of a DECISION round-trip.

OCCUPANT DOMAINS ARE DERIVED, NOT RECALLED (2026-08-04, 2nd violation of ACCEPTANCE-WIDENED-SEAMS in two days — p5's hand list missed table body cells and chart legend/data-label inks until L2 failed the round): when an AC quantifies over ALL X at a seam, the brief's enumeration is GENERATED by a structural grep of every code site that hands the vendor library an X, with the grep command pasted into the brief. A hand-recalled list frozen at cut time is a decomposition defect. An ink the renderer does not NAME is an ink the gate cannot MEASURE.

DISPROVED PREMISES ARE SWEPT DOWNSTREAM (2026-08-04, p5 finding 6: FOR-845 still carried the strip premise p5 disproved, re-arming the identical DECISION stop): when a phase empirically disproves a premise, the done-window ceremony greps sibling and downstream issue descriptions/briefs for the same premise and amends them in the same window. EXTENDED 2026-08-04 (meta-review p6 finding 9: the falsified 'first .potx fixture' premise survived in PR #170's published body and the resume ruling's prose after the divergence was reconciled): the sweep covers the published PR body/prose, not only sibling briefs and issues.

DONE-WINDOW CLOSURE IS MACHINE-CHECKED (2026-08-04, meta-review p6 — p6 closed with 9 in-tree pointers at 'a ticket whose id the conductor writes over this line', no such ticket in Linear, and p7 launched 6 minutes later with the only intervening RULING row sprint-scoped; the OPEN-DECISIONS-RULED-OR-DATED invariant was violated with no gate noticing; first minted id: FOR-854): before the next phase's QUEUED row, the conductor appends a phase-scoped RULING row enumerating a disposition — ruled / dated-deferral-with-owner / minted-ticket-id — for EVERY reconciled STILL-OPEN divergence and EVERY localCr.deferred item of the phase just closed. Mechanical teeth: git grep -n 'whose id the conductor writes over this line' at the phase tip must return ZERO hits before the next launch — placeholder pointers are committed only against a pre-minted ticket id (minted in the lead session, which holds external-write authority). Issue-wording amendments a ruling generates (e.g. FOR-838's tightening-only clamp) are written back in the SAME lead session that rules them, never deferred to the window. AMENDED 2026-08-07 (meta-review p8 finding 6: the done-window posted 'zero deferrals' to Linear over two undisposed STILL-OPEN divergences): dispositions are COMPUTED from the run's reconciledDivergences list, never asserted from memory; and any item routed 'rides the meta-review' must ALSO land in the phase's own ledger row and Linear comment at the window — the meta-review is a second reader, never the only durable record (the p8 review died with the routing inside it).

RULED ARTIFACT-SURFACE DUTIES REACH THEIR OWNER STAGE (2026-08-05, meta-review p7 — the R1 title-slide-only DECISION-NEEDED marker was ordered onto the PR body, but no stage that writes the PR body receives rulings; the marker existed nowhere on PR #171 at review time): a conductor ruling that assigns a duty to a publish-time artifact (PR body, doc, ticket) must reach a stage that writes that artifact — freeze-break item l injects RULING into the Publish and Validate prompts and adds the Validate artifact-duty presence check. UNTIL that lands, any such duty defaults to the CONDUCTOR, executed in the same window with a launch-queue row as evidence.

EXTERNAL-FETCH BOUNDARY ACS (2026-08-05, meta-review p7 — the brief added a server-side fetch of scraped externally-influenced URLs and named only image-quality axes; localCr had to surface SSRF/timeout/byte-cap, deferred to FOR-855): any brief adding a server-side fetch of externally-influenced URLs carries SSRF (loopback/link-local/RFC1918/redirect-target), timeout/cancellation, and streaming byte-cap acceptance criteria — validate-at-boundaries is a standing design principle, not an optional quality axis — OR an explicit non-scope declaration with the follow-up ticket minted at BRIEF-CUT time, not at the done-window.

RESUME ASSERTS THE PRIOR RUN IS LEDGERED (2026-08-05, meta-review p7 — run-2's completed/DECISION-NEEDED terminal state left no workflow-runs.jsonl row; suspect the 01e0e92 stale-terminal-state guard on resumes, ticketed FOR-859): before stamping RESUMED, the conductor verifies the prior run's terminal row exists in workflow-runs.jsonl — archived .runN.json count + RESUMED events must reconcile with ledger rows for the runId. The ceremony check is the rule; the watcher fix is the ticket.

A FLAGGED-FOR-CONDUCTOR ITEM IS CARRIED OR CLOSED, NEVER DROPPED (2026-08-07, meta-review p8 finding 4 — the p5-flagged appearance-baseline door was omitted from the p8 brief and became the proximate cause of run-1's block; 2nd of the brief-omits-a-known-door family): the conductor keeps a carry list keyed by artifact surface; at every brief-cut the list is diffed against the touch-set and each hit is folded in or explicitly closed with rationale.

A NUMERIC-FLOOR AC NAMES ITS DATUM (2026-08-07, meta-review p8 finding 7: the luminance floor bound only a fixture authored by the same commit — satisfiable by construction — while the production accent pair fails the floor 9.4x): a floor/threshold AC names the real-world datum it protects (production config, golden artifact), never solely a same-change fixture. RESOLVED 2026-08-07 (operator-ruled, FOR-865): honor the brand — the luminance floor is an operator accessibility preference on EXTERNAL brand input, not a pipeline invariant. Runtime ADVISORY at brand resolution (typed data, never refusal, never silent mutation) + Checkpoint #2 confirm-with-swappables (user edit WINS) + always-on SECONDARY ENCODING at accent co-occurrence sites (dash/marker/texture, brand hexes untouched).
